# Results summary (generated by scripts/make_figures.py)

All numbers are on held-out test days (112 simulated days). Energy saving is relative to keeping
every cell on. Unserved traffic is a share of all offered traffic. DQN rows are mean ± std over seeds.

## Setting `main`: deep sleep (10% of zero-load power), on/off state held >= 1 hour

Always-on energy: 58.02 kWh/day, unserved 0.0017 %

| Controller | Energy saved | Unserved traffic | Switches per cell per day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Night schedule (tuned) | 12.76 % | 0.0505 % | 2.00 |
| Threshold (tuned) | 28.70 % | 0.0397 % | 3.32 |
| Load-aware threshold (tuned) | 31.79 % | 0.0684 % | 3.40 |
| DQN + traffic types (λ=40, 5 seeds) | 31.33 ± 0.79 % | 0.0829 ± 0.0180 % | 3.60 |
| DQN + traffic types + safety guard | 31.26 ± 0.79 % | 0.0744 ± 0.0137 % | 3.61 |
| DQN without traffic types | 25.41 ± 5.92 % | 0.1813 ± 0.1595 % | 11.21 |
| Clairvoyant bound (knows the future) | 33.72 % | 0.0017 % | 4.31 |

Tuned rule parameters: night {'start_h': 1.0, 'end_h': 8.0}, threshold {'theta': 0.3}, load-aware {'theta': 0.5, 'beta': 0.875}

## Unsupervised stages

- K-means: silhouette picks K = 3; cluster purity against the true area type 0.75 (with K = 4 forced: 1.00); 99.6 % of single days fall in their cell's cluster.
- Anomaly detector on test days: precision 0.807, recall 0.782, F1 0.795 (recall on flash crowds 0.941, on drops 0.575; 0.65 % of samples are anomalies).
